description: This file defines the NotesListViewModel class responsible for managing UI state for a notes list in an Android app. It includes state flows for notes, sync status, and query input, and provides methods to update the query and trigger manual synchronization.

classes.name: NotesListUiState
classes.description: Data class representing the UI state for the notes list, including query string, list of notes, and sync status.

classes.name: NotesListViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing the presentation logic for the notes list, exposing UI state and actions for querying and syncing notes.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query used to filter notes.

methods.name: syncNow
methods.description: Triggers a manual sync of notes, both enqueueing a background worker and attempting immediate sync for front-end update.
